attchmntText: Pranav Constructions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Reg 7(2) of SEBI (PIT) Reg 2015'.
voiceSummary: Pranav Constructions Limited filed Form C with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on 26th November 2026. The filing discloses insider trading transactions by promoters and directors under SEBI regulations. Promoter and Managing Director Pranav Kiran Ashar purchased 20,000 equity shares on 26th November 2026. The transaction value was Rs. 16,73,000. His holding increased from 4,04,96,946 shares to 4,05,16,986 shares. Promoter and Whole-time Director Ravi Ramalingam purchased 11,000 equity shares. The purchase occurred between 23rd November 2026 and 26th November 2026. The transaction value was Rs. 9,17,050. His holding increased from 1,47,21,459 shares to 1,47,32,459 shares. The disclosures were submitted within the prescribed timelines.

attchmntText: Tata Motors Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
voiceSummary: Tata Motors Limited reports that its shareholding in Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited has increased from 48.98% to 50.17%. This change occurred following the completion of a buyback of equity shares by ACGL through the tender offer route and the subsequent extinguishment of those shares. Consequently, ACGL has become a subsidiary of Tata Motors Limited and ceased to be an associate company. The transaction does not involve direct acquisition of shares by Tata Motors and is not classified as a related party transaction. No governmental or regulatory approvals are required. The increase in shareholding is 1.19%, resulting from the buyback of 1,44,639 equity shares. ACGL operates in the automotive engineering and manufacturing sector. Its revenue from operations for FY26 is reported as 933,65,49,000 rupees. The acquisition details were completed on November 26, 2026.

attchmntText: Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
voiceSummary: Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited has informed the exchanges that Crisil Ratings Limited has reaffirmed its credit rating on the company's long-term bank facilities. The facilities amount to 5600 Cr. The rating remains Crisil BBB/Watch Negative, continuing on Rating Watch with Negative Implications. The rating action is listed as Reaffirmed. The revised ratings rationale dated 26th November, 2026 is available on the Crisil Ratings website. The intimation was issued by Whole-Time Director Savan Jayendra Patel, DIN 02687808, on November 26, 2026.

attchmntText: Expleo Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update/ Clarification On Machine Readable Form/ Legible Copy Of Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026'.
voiceSummary: Expleo Solutions Limited submitted machine-readable financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. The Board approved standalone revenue of 5,156.01 million and profit after tax of 606.00 million for the six-month period. The company appointed Mr. Bastien Georges Andre Lefranc, with DIN 11768456, as Additional Director, subject to shareholder approval. On November 26, 2026, the company clarified that previously submitted documents contained pages that were not fully legible. These pages have been converted to a machine-readable format. The company confirmed there are no changes to the financial results previously submitted.

attchmntText: Max Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Max Financial Services Limited announces that its senior management will participate in the Nirmal Bang Institutional Equities Investors Conference on December 1, 2026. The event will be conducted virtually as a group meeting. The company confirms that no unpublished price-sensitive information is intended to be discussed during these interactions. An investor presentation is available on the company website at www.maxfinancialservices.com and on stock exchanges. A copy of this communication will also be uploaded to the company website for public information. The meetings are subject to changes due to exigencies.

attchmntText: Jindal Poly Films Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Jindal Poly Films Limited disclosed an extension of the standstill period under the Standstill Agreement dated November 13, 2026. The parties mutually agreed to extend the standstill by an additional 5 days, ending on 30 November 2026. This extension aims to explore an amicable settlement of disputes involving JPFL Films Private Limited and Project Holdings Fourteen DIFC Limited. The standstill covers pending proceedings, including a petition before the National Company Law Tribunal, arbitration under Singapore International Arbitration Centre rules, and proceedings before the High Court of the Republic of Singapore. No settlement has been reached as of the disclosure date. The Investor holds approximately 38% of the Company's paid-up share capital on a fully diluted basis. The Company holds approximately 99.98% of JPFL Films. No consideration is payable under the Amendment Agreement.

sm_name: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited
attchmntText: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September 2026. The advertisements were published in Mumbai Lakshdeep and Financial Express on 26th November 2026. The company also disclosed that it has invoked security measures under the SARFAESI Act, 2002, and the Security Interest Enforcement Rules, 2002. This action was taken against borrowers Sanket Patil and Bhaskar Parajamp, who reside in Raigad, Maharashtra. The company issued a demand notice for the recovery of Rs. 2,52,99,21/- due on 11th May 2026. The notice required repayment within 60 days. The company stated that if the dues are not cleared, it may take possession of the secured assets. The borrowers were informed of their right to appeal to the Debt Recovery Tribunal.

attchmntText: ESDS Software Solution Limited has informed the Exchange about Analyst(s)/Investor(s) meet.
voiceSummary: ESDS Software Solution Limited has intimated the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited regarding an investor meeting scheduled for December 01, 2026. The meeting is a one-on-one session with Bajaj General Insurance. The event will be conducted virtually. The company states that the schedule is subject to change. During the meeting, only corporate and earnings presentations hosted on the company website and other publicly available information will be shared and referred. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The notice was issued on November 26, 2026. Prasad Deochand Deokar, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication.

attchmntText: Sheetal Cool Products Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Sheetal Cool Products Limited has intimated the schedule for analyst and institutional investor meetings under SEBI Listing Regulations. The company will participate in the India Manthan Virtual Forum 2026, hosted by YES Securities Virtual Group. The meeting is scheduled for December 2, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM IST. The session will be conducted via virtual mode. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during the meeting. Discussions will be based strictly on publicly available information. Investor coordination inquiries may be directed to Capital Bridge Advisors.

attchmntText: SIL Investments Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: SIL Investments Limited published a notice in Business Standard and Dainik Bhaskar regarding the opening of a special window for transfer and dematerialization of physical securities. The Securities and Exchange Board of India issued an advisory on November 23, 2026, directing intermediaries to stop publishing grey market premiums for initial public offerings. The Supreme Court directed courts to verify if homebuyers defaulted on loans before permitting coercive recovery in stalled housing projects. APL Apollo Tubes shares fell over 30 per cent as the market reacted to the proposed acquisition of Tata Steel’s tubes and metal businesses for approximately 28,000 crore. Tata Steel will acquire a 26.38 per cent stake in APL Apollo at approximately 2,100 per share. Info Edge India Limited announced a special window from February 5, 2026, to February 4, 2027, for the transfer and dematerialization of physical shares.

attchmntText: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Receipt of Letter of Award from Directorate of Tourism, Government of Meghalaya
voiceSummary: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited received a Letter of Award from the Directorate of Tourism, Government of Meghalaya on November 25, 2026. The company is declared the Selected Bidder to develop, operate, and maintain a 5-star business hotel at Umsawli, New Shillong Township, Meghalaya. The project follows a Design, Build, Finance, Operate, and Transfer basis under Public Private Partnership for a concession period of 60 years. The hotel will have a minimum of 120 rooms. The company will pay an upfront premium of 7 crore rupees, an annual concession fee, lease rental, and a revenue share of 4.15 percent of gross revenue. Construction is scheduled for three years. The project cost is not determinable at this stage. As of September 30, 2026, the company operates 43 hotels with 2729 keys.

attchmntText: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited has intimated that its Board meeting is scheduled for December 01, 2026. The Board will consider a proposal to raise funds via a preferential issue of equity shares through private placement. This Proposed Preferential Issue is subject to shareholder approval and other regulatory approvals. The company may convene an extraordinary general meeting or use a postal ballot process to seek this approval. Additionally, the trading window for designated persons and their immediate relatives is closed from Friday, November 27, 2026, until further notice. This closure is pursuant to the company's Code of Conduct for Prohibition of Insider Trading and SEBI PIT Regulations.

attchmntText: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Texmaco Rail and Engineering Limited has received an order from Utkal Alumina International Ltd. The contract involves the manufacture and supply of 108 wagons, comprising BTAPM1 and BVCM wagon types. The order value is Rs. 55.63 crores, including taxes. The entity awarding the order is domestic. The contract execution is scheduled to be completed by 30th September, 2027. There is no interest held by promoters or their group companies in the entity that awarded the order. The transaction does not fall within related party transactions. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Incorporation of Step- Down Subsidiaries. The disclosure is attached herewith.
voiceSummary: KPI Green Energy Limited intimates the incorporation of five wholly owned step-down subsidiaries on November 26, 2026. The entities are KPGC Six Private Limited, KPGC Seven Private Limited, KPGC Eight Private Limited, KPGC Nine Private Limited, and KPGC Ten Private Limited. These companies were incorporated by Sun Drops Energia Limited, a subsidiary of KPI Green Energy Limited. Each new entity has an authorized capital of Rs. 1,00,000, comprising 10,000 equity shares of Rs. 10 each. The subscription cost for each company is Rs. 1,00,000. Sun Drops Energia Limited holds 100% shareholding in all five entities. The businesses operate in the renewable energy sector, focusing on generating, storing, transmitting, and distributing electricity from solar, wind, hydro, biomass, and thermal sources. Turnover is nil as operations have not commenced. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Brigade Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
voiceSummary: Brigade Enterprises Limited has informed the exchanges that ICRA Limited reaffirmed and assigned enhanced credit ratings for various credit facilities. The long term fund based term loan rating of ICRA AA Stable is reassigned for an enhanced amount of Rs. 3929 crore from Rs. 2423 crore. The long term unallocated limits rating of ICRA AA Stable is reassigned for an enhanced amount of Rs. 296 crore from Rs. 227 crore. The commercial paper rating of ICRA A1 Plus is reaffirmed and reassigned for an enhanced amount of Rs. 500 crore from Rs. 200 crore. The short term fund based cash credit and overdraft facilities rating of ICRA A1 Plus is reaffirmed for a reduced amount of Rs. 275 crore from Rs. 350 crore. These ratings were assigned on November 24, 2026.

attchmntText: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has announced the closure of its trading window for designated persons. The restriction is effective from 27th November, 2026, until 48 hours after the announcement of the Board Meeting outcome. The Board Meeting is scheduled for 1st December, 2026. This closure applies to promoters, directors, key managerial personnel, designated employees, connected persons, and their immediate relatives. These individuals are advised not to deal in the company's shares directly or indirectly during this period. The notice is issued pursuant to the SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Commercial Syn Bags Limited intimates that its Board of Directors approved the re-designation of key managerial personnel on 26th November 2026. Mr. Sandeep Patel is re-designated from Company Secretary to Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective 27th November 2026. Mr. Abhishek Jain is re-designated from Chief Financial Officer and Compliance Officer to Chief Financial Officer, also effective 27th November 2026. Mr. Patel holds membership number F13157 with the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and has over seven years of experience. Mr. Jain holds membership number A19827 with the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and has over ten years of experience. The company has filed this disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 26, 2026.
voiceSummary: Commercial Syn Bags Limited approved the allotment of 3,25,000 warrants of Rs. 283/- each to six promoter and promoter group members on preferential basis. The warrants are convertible into 3,25,000 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each at a premium of Rs. 273/- per share. Upfront payment of Rs. 70.75 per warrant is required, with the balance of Rs. 212.25 payable within 18 months. Allottees include Shri Mohan Lal Choudhary, Shri Anil Choudhary, Shri Ravindra Choudhary, Shri Pramal Choudhary, Smt Vidhya Choudhary, and Shri Ashay Choudhary. The securities are subject to lock-in restrictions under SEBI ICDR Regulations, 2018. The Board also approved the re-designation of Mr. Sandeep Patel as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, and Mr. Abhishek Jain as Chief Financial Officer, effective 27th November, 2026.

attchmntText: Manomay Tex India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 26, 2026, titled "Press Release Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015".
voiceSummary: Manomay Tex India Limited announced an investment of approximately Rs. 48.60 crore to install an 8.80 MW AC and 13.20 MW DC solar power plant in Chohtan, Barmer, Rajasthan. The facility will supply renewable energy to the company's denim and spinning units in Chittorgarh. The company is also expanding its denim division by ordering machinery for a ready for dyeing line and strengthening its spinning division with new spindles for coarse count yarn. This expansion is expected to increase yarn production capacity by approximately 1,080 metric tons per year. The announcement was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Team India Guaranty Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 26, 2026.
voiceSummary: Team India Guaranty Limited approved proposals to increase its overall borrowing limit from 200 Crores to 350 Crores and to raise funds via private placement of Non-Convertible Debentures. Both matters are subject to shareholder approval through Postal Ballot. The Board also approved enhancing monetary limits for Material Related Party Transactions with Team India Managers Limited and Mr. Surajkumar Saraogi from 200 Crores to 350 Crores each. These transactions involve corporate guarantees, personal guarantees, security, and credit support for the Company's borrowings. This enhancement is also subject to prior member approval via Postal Ballot under Regulation 23(4) of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The Board approved the draft Postal Ballot Notice for these three items. Specific details regarding the NCD issuance, such as size, tenure, and coupon rates, remain to be determined by the Board. The Board meeting concluded at 03:39 P.M. on November 26, 2026.

attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith Press Release titled "The Leela Expands its Leisure Portfolio with two new signings in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands".
voiceSummary: Leela Palaces Hotels and Resorts Limited filed a press release regarding the signing of two new luxury resorts in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The company will manage these properties for the Sheeraj Group under hotel management agreements. The projects involve 160 keys across Sri Vijaya Puram and Shaheed Dweep. The Leela Sri Vijaya Puram, with 100 keys, is slated to open in 2029. The Leela Shaheed Dweep, with 60 keys, is expected to open in 2030. The developments are ground-up projects on long-term public-private partnership concessions with the Andaman and Nicobar Islands Integrated Development Corporation. This expansion strengthens the brand's presence in India's luxury leisure market.

attchmntText: Patanjali Foods Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 26, 2026, declared 2nd Interim Dividend for the FY 2026-27 of Rs. 1.25 per equity share.
voiceSummary: Patanjali Foods Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 26, 2026. The Board declared a second interim dividend of Rs. 1.25 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. This dividend represents 62.5% of the face value of Rs. 2 per share. The record date for determining shareholder eligibility is fixed as December 11, 2026. The dividend payment is scheduled to be made on or before December 25, 2026. The meeting commenced at 2.30 PM and concluded at 3.20 PM on November 26, 2026.

attchmntText: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited has appointed Ms. Rajashree Ansurkar as Chief Legal Officer, categorized as senior management, with effect from 1st January 2027. The Board of Directors approved this appointment via circular resolution on 26 November 2026 at 10:06 am, based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Ms. Ansurkar holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree, a Bachelor of Law degree from the University of Mumbai, and a Diploma in Business Management. She possesses over 35 years of experience in the legal profession, including more than 26 years with Mahindra and Mahindra Limited, where she currently serves as Vice President – Legal for Farm Equipment Business, Two-wheeler and Agri business, GCO and group companies. She joined Mahindra and Mahindra Limited in 1999. The appointment carries no specified term. Ms. Ansurkar is not related to any Director of the Company. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Siemens Energy India Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 25, 2026, recommended Final Dividend of Rs. 12 per equity share.
voiceSummary: Siemens Energy India Limited Board approved audited financial results for the year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 17,809 million rupees, up from 11,001 million rupees in the previous year. Revenue from operations stood at 102,432 million rupees. The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 12 per equity share, totaling 600 percent, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting. Payment is scheduled for February 10, 2027. Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP issued an unmodified audit opinion on the financial statements. The Board meeting concluded on November 25, 2026.
